topic: Inscrições abertas para formação gratuita em empreendedorismo cultural da Liga Criativa, em Condado Notícia Preta Brasil
insights: The Liga Criativa is offering free training in cultural entrepreneurship focused on personal development and creative business structuring.
Enrollment for the program is open until all spots are filled, starting from August 11, 2026.
The training is designed for artists, producers, technicians, students, and cultural agents.

quotes.text: abrir novas possibilidades para suas trajetórias
quotes.attribution: Eliz Galvão, founder of Liga Criativa

summary: The Liga Criativa has opened registrations for a free cultural entrepreneurship training program in Condado, focusing on personal and business development. The program aims to empower young individuals in the cultural sector and is available until all spots are filled.
